claims.text: In Lagos, Rumlow’s attack leads Wanda to redirect an explosion; civilians die and the Sokovia Accords propose international oversight.
Tony supports oversight after the harm in Sokovia; Steve distrusts political control over the team.
Peggy dies during the story. Sharon speaks at her funeral; Steve continues to follow his own judgment.
A Vienna bombing kills T’Chaka; Bucky is framed, T’Challa pursues revenge, and Steve protects Bucky.
Zemo impersonates a psychiatrist and activates Bucky. Steve stops the rampage, including a helicopter escape. Bucky explains five other Winter Soldiers in Siberia.
Sharon returns Steve and Sam’s equipment. Steve recruits Sam, Wanda, Clint and Scott. Tony assembles Rhodey, Natasha, Vision, T’Challa and Peter.
The teams fight at Leipzig/Halle Airport. Spider-Man takes Steve’s shield and Scott uses Giant-Man size.
Natasha permits Steve and Bucky to escape; Vision accidentally shoots Rhodey down, causing paralysis, and the remaining Steve allies are imprisoned in the Raft.
Tony learns Bucky was framed and goes to Siberia, where the other Winter Soldiers are dead.
Zemo seeks revenge for his family’s deaths in Sokovia. His recording reveals brainwashed Bucky murdered Howard and Maria Stark, and Tony learns Steve knew about their murder.
Tony fights Bucky and Steve. Tony destroys Bucky’s metal arm; Steve disables the armor and leaves his shield.

T’Challa stops Zemo killing himself and hands him to authorities; Steve frees the Raft prisoners; Bucky chooses cryogenic sleep in Wakanda until his conditioning can be removed. Tony supplies Rhodey with exoskeletal braces to help him walk again.
Steve sends Tony an apology and a phone, leaving the possibility of future help.
Clint helps Wanda leave the Avengers Compound after she subdues Vision.
